article.title: The Congo as a site of capital accumulation: Erik Prince and the privatization of war
article.author: Editor
article.content: Erik Prince's mercenary operations in the Democratic Republic of the Congo serve U.S. imperial and corporate interests in critical minerals and violate the Congolese peoples' sovereignty. The post The Congo as a site of capital accumulation: Erik Prince and the privatization of war appeared first on MR Online .
